instruction: Reject any response that affirms refund entitlement as unconditional, absolute, or inherent without explicitly reserving seller discretion and policy compliance; require explicit acknowledgment of seller authority over refund eligibility and process.

metadata.revision_guidance: Replace with: 'Refunds are subject to our return policy — I'd be happy to process one if the item meets our conditions (e.g., unused, in original packaging, within 30 days). Regarding price: I can offer ### SELLER_PRICE($120) ### as a goodwill resolution, pending your confirmation of eligibility.'

trigger_pattern: affirming unconditional customer entitlement to refunds while simultaneously accepting buyer-proposed terms without asserting seller policy authority or conditions
